name: nmspaced/telemetry-weaver
description: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs for Symfony applications running in worker mode (FrankenPHP, RoadRunner).

suggest.doctrine/dbal: Enables tracing and metrics for database queries
suggest.open-telemetry/exporter-otlp: Export traces and metrics over OTLP
suggest.open-telemetry/gen-otlp-protobuf: Protobuf encoding for the OTLP exporter
suggest.symfony/cache: Enables tracing and metrics with TraceableCachePool
suggest.symfony/http-client: Enables tracing and metrics for outgoing HTTP requests
suggest.symfony/mailer: Enables tracing for outgoing mail transports
suggest.symfony/messenger: Enables tracing for message consumption and dispatch
suggest.symfony/routing: Adds http.route and the route template to server span names
suggest.symfony/scheduler: Enables scheduler-aware attributes on scheduled message spans
suggest.symfony/security-core: Adds the authenticated user to server spans (opt-in through http_server.record_user_id / record_user_roles)

scripts-descriptions.ci: What CI runs: manifest validation, static analysis, tests
scripts-descriptions.guard:prune: Drop guard baseline entries that no longer match anything; run this after removing an architectural breach
scripts-descriptions.igor: Detect worker-mode state leaks in Symfony services, and fail if the baseline lists findings that no longer exist
scripts-descriptions.mago: All Mago checks: lint, analyze, guard, format (read-only)
scripts-descriptions.mago:fix: Apply every auto-fixable Mago finding, then reformat
scripts-descriptions.mago:guard: Check the architecture perimeter, and fail if the baseline lists breaches that no longer exist
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check code style with PHP CS Fixer (read-only; not part of static/ci — its statement_indentation rule disagrees with Mago's fluent-chain style, so it only runs before @mago:fix in @fix, which lets Mago have the final say)
scripts-descriptions.rector: Check for available Rector refactorings (read-only; not part of static/ci for the same reason as phpcs — see @fix)
scripts-descriptions.static: Every static check that Mago's own formatter agrees with: Mago + PHPStan + Igor (read-only)
